Third-party libraries bundled so the dashboard works without a CDN.

Chart.js 4.4.1 (chart.umd.js) - MIT licence - https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.4.1/LICENSE.md
Leaflet 1.9.4 (leaflet.js, leaflet.css) - BSD 2-Clause licence - https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/v1.9.4/LICENSE

Map tiles: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
